summary: Northern California, web designer and developer, former college-level instructor, freelance work for small to medium-sized businesses, strong interest in typography and visual design, experience with ProcessWire CMS, advocate for mental health awareness, family-oriented with a wife and three kids, former film major, interest in 3D modeling and illustration, engaged in discussions about online therapy and mental health, critical of corporate work environments, values work-life balance, uses a variety of productivity tools and techniques, enjoys reading and sharing knowledge about design and technology.
